At first glance, it appears straightforward: The state budget comprises three main spending categories: education, healthcare and social services, along with general government expenses. These categories always grow during good economic times as tax receipts grow to match the growth in incomes.
But the truth is that is easy when times are good but more challenging when times are tough.
